MoveSmart Rentals is hiring an experienced Client Relationship Manager to manage property-owner relationships throughout the residential leasing process.
You will keep owners informed, influence important decisions, overcome objections, sell relevant services, and keep each file moving from listing through tenant move-in.
This is not a basic customer-service position. You must be comfortable challenging unrealistic expectations, handling difficult conversations, and asking clients to make timely decisions.

Direct real-estate experience is preferred but not required. Strong candidates from account management, consultative sales, customer success, client retention, relationship management, or another service-based industry are encouraged to apply.
If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email within 24–48 hours containing a link to complete a short prerecorded video interview.
The interview includes realistic sales, objection-handling, and client-relationship scenarios.
Candidates selected to continue will be invited to a live interview.
Manage multiple active property-owner and leasing files.
Act as a primary point of contact throughout the leasing process.
Provide proactive updates about listings, showings, feedback, applications, offers, and next steps.
Identify why a property is not attracting sufficient interest or qualified applicants.
Use market information and showing feedback to recommend price changes.
Present qualified tenant offers and secure timely owner decisions.
Sell professional marketing, property improvements, and other appropriate services.
Explain the financial impact of continued vacancy.
Handle objections while maintaining the owner’s trust.
Retain dissatisfied owners who may be considering cancellation.
Secure owner cooperation with keys, lockboxes, property access, cleaning, and move-in requirements.
Explain payment and payout processes accurately.
Address conflicting advertising or agreement-related concerns.
Communicate with owners, tenants, realtors, vendors, and internal teams.
Maintain accurate CRM notes, tasks, documents, and follow-ups.
Escalate legal, payment, agreement, or high-risk concerns when required.
Three or more years of experience in account management, consultative sales, customer success, client retention, relationship management, leasing, property management, or another client-facing role.
Experience managing ongoing client relationships—not only completing one-time sales.
Demonstrated ability to overcome objections and persuade clients to act.
Experience retaining dissatisfied clients or recovering difficult relationships.
Confidence recommending price changes, services, or property improvements.
Experience presenting offers, recommendations, or solutions to clients.
Ability to use evidence, feedback, and financial reasoning to influence decisions.
Strong organization, follow-up, and deadline management.
Ability to manage multiple clients, files, transactions, or opportunities.
Experience using a CRM or structured workflow system.
Sound judgment when handling complaints, resistance, and escalations.
Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
Canadian real-estate or leasing experience is an asset but is not mandatory. Training will be provided on MoveSmart’s services, systems, and leasing process.
The right person combines strong relationship-management skills with consultative sales ability.
You must be able to listen to a client’s concern, identify the real objection, explain the evidence, recommend a solution, and ask for a decision.

You should be persuasive without being misleading or aggressive. You must know when to continue selling, when to enforce a company requirement, and when a legal, financial, or agreement-related issue must be escalated.

Calo is seeking a commercially mature, systems-driven Head of Growth to architect and scale a unified Growth Operating System across all markets.
This role is responsible for end-to-end growth performance across all Mountain Peaks (MPs), owning performance marketing, lifecycle/CRM, SEO, CRO, and building a dedicated growth analytics function.

The Head of Growth will transition Calo away from a media-buying-led performance organization to an incrementality-driven, commercially disciplined growth engine grounded in contribution margin, payback modeling, and long-term value creation.
This is a strategic builder role, not a channel operator position.

Location: Open globally. Candidates must have at least 5 hours overlap with KSA working hours. Hybrid in countries where Calo has offices (KSA, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman); otherwise fully remote.

Would you like to join WYCON Milano’s Headquarters in Dubai and contribute to the international expansion of a fast-growing beauty brand?
If you are looking for a professional opportunity in Dubai within a dynamic, structured and international environment, this could be the right opportunity for you.

WYCON Milano is an Italian beauty brand founded in 2009 by Gianfranco Satta and Raffaella Pagano, with the aim of making high-quality make-up accessible through a combination of innovation, performance and Made in Italy style.

Today, WYCON Milano has over 300 stores worldwide, with an established presence in key markets across Europe, Asia, the Middle East and North Africa, supported by an ambitious international expansion plan.

WYCON MILANO is looking for a highly experienced Global Marketing Director, with a proven track record in the strategic and operational leadership of marketing functions for established brands with national and international recognition.

The successful candidate will be responsible for defining, leading and implementing the brand’s global marketing strategy, contributing to strengthening its positioning, brand awareness, desirability and market competitiveness.
The ideal candidate will have a comprehensive and integrated vision of marketing, a strong aesthetic sensibility and in-depth knowledge of the beauty and consumer markets.
We are looking for a leader who has successfully managed the entire marketing function, not a specialist in just one area.

The selected candidate must be able to combine the development of an aspirational brand image with commercial objectives and the fast-paced dynamics of an accessible brand targeting a broad consumer audience.
